jobs.title: Workforce Management - Real Time Analyst
jobs.jd_full:
About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

Overview

📍 Remote Global - Central and South America

We are seeking a WFM Central - Real Time Analyst to serve as the central governance layer for live operations across multiple Lines of Business (LoB). This is not a traditional monitoring role; it is designed for a high-caliber, forensic operator who functions as an operational architect. You will be a trusted partner to operational leadership, responsible for continuing to evolve our operations to a standardized, and fiscally sound control model.

The ideal candidate possesses the technical "know-how" of a forensic analyst and the communication prowess of a business consultant, capable of telling a compelling story through data to stakeholders ranging from Team Leads to Directors. You won't just report that a queue is at risk; you will diagnose the business impact, identify the root cause, and prescribe the specific levers leadership must pull to preserve SLA and the customer experience. You will be the owner of all aspects of the support queues and ensure we are meeting our customers where they need us.

Responsibilities

  • Stakeholder Storytelling: Distill complex, "noisy" operational signals into high-impact narratives. You must be able to share in-depth observations and supporting data that tell a clear story to stakeholders, at all levels of leadership, on exactly what actions must be taken.

  • Business-Level Analysis: Go beyond the "what" and the "why" to analyze long-term business trends. Evaluate the financial efficiency of SLA safeguarding and the fiscal impact of current staffing vs. demand density.

  • Operational Control & Forensic Auditing: Serve as the authoritative "voice of reason" during incidents. Conduct forensic audits of agent behaviors such as "On Hold" abuse or status irregularities to ensure hidden capacity drains are eliminated.

  • Centralized Core Governance: Enact queue management playbooks for real-time levers across multiple LoBs, ensuring aggressive SLAs are preserved through structured accountability.

  • Strategic Planning & Optimization: Partner with WFM to create a concise feedback loop for continued improvement in planning and scheduling.

Qualifications

  • Exceptional Communication: Proven ability to translate complex data into a clear jargon-free business story. You must be comfortable presenting actionable insights to senior leadership under high-pressure conditions.

  • Advanced Forensic Analysis: Expert proficiency in Google Sheets is required, familiarity with Metabase preferred. You must be able to build complex, automated tracking tools and forensic audits from scratch. Not just for basic queue health, but also analyzing business data that influences our operations.

  • Strategic Judgment: Demonstrated experience making high-judgment decisions that impact the entire business, particularly in environments with aggressive SLAs and fluctuating volume patterns.

  • Operational Architecture: Take ownership in documenting best practices into governed frameworks and playbooks.

  • Resilient Mindset: Comfortable operating autonomously in a 24/7 environment, with the flexibility to adapt to operational needs as part of a high-impact, interdependent team.

  • Systems Fluency: Familiarity with Amazon Connect, Zendesk Omnichannel routing, and Assembled WFM is highly preferred.

What Success Looks Like

  • Operational anomalies are quickly investigated, with root causes clearly identified and communicated, reducing repeat issues and leadership uncertainty

  • You evolve queue management processes from reactive to a documented, standardized, and predictive operating model.

  • Champion of the team’s brand with Operational Leadership. You are looked to as the primary source of truth, relying on your data-driven stories to make critical staffing and operational decisions.

  • Live queues remain stable, governed, and resilient across all supported lines of business, even during unexpected spikes, outages, or incidents

  • Stakeholders receive timely, clear updates during incidents that explain impact, cause, and corrective actions in a concise and actionable manner.

Hiring Process

  • Application

  • Intro Call with Recruiter

  • Case Study

  • Interview with Central WFM - RTA Team Lead

  • Interview with Queue Operations Manager - Core Services

  • Interview with Head of Core Services

  • Final Culture Interview with Executive Leadership

Quick Note on Scammers:

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here.

jobs.title: Operations Specialist - Remote (MX, BR or AR)
jobs.jd_full:
About the Role

We're looking for an Operations Specialist to help transform how we scale and deliver talent for high-growth AI projects.

You'll join our team within Expert Operations (XOps), working to simplify complex workflows, eliminate repetitive tasks, and build AI-powered automations that help us meet contributor demand efficiently and at scale.

This is a hands-on role with a high degree of ownership, ideal for someone who enjoys solving operational challenges, experimenting with AI tools, and turning manual processes into smarter, more scalable systems.

Location & Work Authorization Requirements

This is a remote position open exclusively to candidates currently based in Argentina, Brazil, or Mexico.

Applicants must reside in one of these three countries and have valid legal authorization to work in their country of residence. Both requirements are mandatory to be considered for this role.

Your Impact

  • Map and analyse end-to-end fulfillment workflows, from project headcount requests through contributor activation, to identify opportunities for automation and process improvement.

  • Design, build, and maintain AI agents, automated workflows, and internal tools that streamline recruiting and fulfillment operations.

  • Leverage AI-assisted sourcing tools to build targeted contributor pipelines efficiently and at scale.

  • Automate repetitive sourcing activities, including talent targeting, profile identification, and skills mapping.

  • Develop and maintain automated dashboards and reports to track recruitment funnels, conversion rates, and fulfillment progress.

  • Identify operational bottlenecks and implement scalable solutions that improve efficiency, accuracy, and productivity.

  • Document workflows, establish best practices, and support team members in adopting new tools and processes.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to identify automation opportunities and continuously improve operational performance.

Success in this role means building reliable, scalable automations that reduce manual work, improve operational efficiency, and enable our Fulfillment team to meet growing project demands.

What You Bring

  • 2+ years of experience in operations, process improvement, data analysis, automation, or a related field, ideally within AI, technology, marketplace, or high-growth environments.

  • Demonstrated experience identifying inefficiencies, improving business processes, and transforming manual workflows into scalable solutions.

  • Strong hands-on experience using AI models and tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, or similar platforms to build practical workflows or AI agents.

  • Experience integrating Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools into automation workflows.

  • Strong analytical and data management skills, including proficiency in Excel.

  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of projects, and solve problems in fast-changing environments.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to document processes and support the adoption of new technologies.

  • Curiosity, adaptability, and enthusiasm for exploring emerging AI technologies and applying them to real operational challenges.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with automation platforms or scripting tools such as Python, Google Apps Script, Zapier, Make, or similar.

  • Experience working with APIs, complex JSON data structures, Git, or version control.

  • Knowledge of SQL and data visualization or reporting tools.

  • Experience developing, deploying, or maintaining autonomous AI agents or agentic workflows.

  • Familiarity with AI-powered sourcing, recruitment operations, contributor management, or talent acquisition tools.

  • Experience supporting large-scale, global operations or cross-functional teams.

Compensation

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Credit Cards) - Canada
jobs.jd_full:
At NerdWallet, we’re on a mission to bring clarity to all of life’s financial decisions​ and every great mission needs a team of exceptional Nerds. We’ve built an inclusive, flexible, and candid culture where you’re empowered to grow, take smart risks, and be unapologetically yourself (cape optional). Whether remote or in-office, we support how you thrive best. We invest in your well-being, development, and ability to make an impact​ because when one Nerd levels up, we all do.

As a Senior Product Manager (Credit Cards), you’ll own and evolve digital experiences that help consumers shop for, compare, and choose the right credit card for their needs. You’ll have the opportunity to shape high-impact surfaces and tools used by millions of consumers to make better financial decisions, while directly contributing to NerdWallet’s business goals.

This role blends product strategy with hands-on execution. You’ll identify consumer needs and opportunities, turn insights into product solutions, and partner across data, engineering, design, content, and marketing to bring those experiences to life. You’ll work closely with Performance Marketing to create and optimize paid-channel experiences, while also supporting our organic experiences and the tools that surface relevant credit card offers.

We’re also looking for a product builder who embraces new ways of working. You’ll use AI as part of your day-to-day product development process to accelerate discovery, analysis, prototyping, validation, and delivery. You’ll have room to experiment, create new experiences, and turn effective workflows into reusable tools that help the broader team move faster and increase its impact.

This role will report to the Director Product Management for the Cards and Wealth teams.

Where you can make an impact:

  • Own the product roadmap. Develop and evolve the roadmap for NerdWallet’s paid and organic credit card experiences, connecting product priorities to consumer needs and company goals.

  • Build experiences that help consumers make confident decisions. Use market insights, competitive research, and an understanding of consumers’ financial behaviors, goals, and challenges to identify opportunities and solve meaningful problems.

  • Drive paid-channel performance. Partner closely with Performance Marketing to design, test, and refine experiences for consumers arriving through paid channels, balancing business performance with a seamless consumer journey.

  • Turn insights into measurable outcomes. Define and monitor key product metrics and use experimentation, including A/B testing, to improve engagement, conversion, and overall product performance.

  • Create and ship with AI. Use AI tools to accelerate your day-to-day work, build working prototypes, validate ideas, and ship solutions. Turn successful approaches into reusable tools that can scale impact across the team.

  • Lead through collaboration. Work closely with engineering, design, data, content, and marketing partners to move from strategy to execution and deliver product enhancements and new experiences.

  • Support organic experiences. Partner with content and SEO teams to improve the experiences and components that help consumers discover and evaluate relevant credit card offers.

  • Build strong product integrations. Collaborate with external partners to develop integrations that enhance our consumer experiences and functionality.

  • Advocate for the consumer. Keep consumers and their needs at the center of product decisions while balancing customer outcomes with business objectives.

  • Help the team grow. Support and mentor team members and contribute to a collaborative culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Your experience:

  • 5+ years in product management, preferably within fintech, consumer finance, or related domain.

  • A track record of owning, launching, and improving consumer product experiences with measurable impact.

  • Experience leading consumer product experiences that grow through SEO and paid marketing channels, with accountability for performance metrics such as conversion rate, cost per acquisition, or ROAS.

  • Experience influencing cross-functional teams and driving outcomes without direct authority.

  • A hands-on approach to AI, using AI tools as part of your regular product workflow to accelerate research, analysis, documentation, prototyping, or delivery.

  • Experience building and shipping working prototypes or tools yourself using modern AI tools, including agentic coding assistants or rapid prototyping platforms, and turning effective workflows into reusable solutions others can adopt.

  • Strong analytical skills and experience using data to inform product decisions, including familiarity with A/B testing and user research.

  • Comfort partnering with engineering teams and working with API integrations and technical workflows.

  • A customer-focused approach and commitment to creating useful, intuitive product experiences.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical partners.

Where:

  • This is a remote position and a person can be located anywhere in Canada (with the exception of Quebec).

  • NerdWallet is proud to be a remote-first company! We believe great work can be done anywhere. No matter where you are based, NerdWallet offers benefits and perks to support the physical, financial, and emotional well being of you and your family.

What we offer:

Work Hard, Stay Balanced (Life’s a series of balancing acts, eh?)

  • Monthly Healthcare Stipend

  • Rejuvenation Policy – Vacation Time Off + You will receive the official public holidays in your province

  • Paid sabbatical for Nerds to recharge, gain knowledge and pursue their interests

  • Monthly Wellness Stipend, Wifi Stipend, and Cell Phone Stipend

  • Work from home equipment stipend

Have Some Fun! (Nerds are fun, too)

  • Nerd-led group initiatives – Employee Resource Groups for Parents, Diversity, and Inclusion, Women, LGBTQIA, and other communities

  • Hackathons and team events across all teams and departments

  • Company-wide events like NerdLove (employee appreciation) and our annual Charity Auction

Plan for your future (And when you retire on your island, remember the little people)

  • RRSP with a 4% match. Eligible one month after hire.

  • Financial wellness, guidance, and unlimited access to a Certified Financial Planner (CFP) through Northstar

NerdWallet is committed to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law, so all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

jobs.jd_full:
This is a remote position.

Location: Latin America Only (Remote)
Employment Type: Full-Time / Contractor
About NetForemost
NetForemost is a software development and digital solutions company powering high-performing teams across the globe. We build modern digital products by combining Agile delivery practices with AI-native workflows. We believe in continuous learning, transparency, ownership, and empowering early-career professionals to grow into world-class project leaders.
Role Summary
Are you an organized, communicative, and detail-oriented professional looking to start or accelerate your career in IT Project Management?
As a Junior Project Manager at NetForemost, you will work closely with Senior PMs, software engineers, QA testers, and UI/UX designers to support the day-to-day coordination of Agile software development projects. You will help keep teams aligned, maintain project documentation, assist in Agile ceremonies, and ensure smooth communication with stakeholders—all while learning industry best practices and leveraging modern AI tools.

Position Overview

As a Project Manager at NetForemost, you will be responsible for coordinating and overseeing the execution of software development projects throughout the sprint lifecycle.

You will work closely with clients, developers, QA engineers, designers, and leadership teams to ensure project visibility, team alignment, risk mitigation, and successful delivery of outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines strong organizational and communication skills with an understanding of Agile methodologies, project metrics, and software development processes.

Key Responsibilities
- Agile Support & Coordination: Help facilitate daily standups, sprint planning support, and sprint reviews alongside the team lead.
- Task & Backlog Management: Maintain and organize user stories, tasks, and project documentation in Jira and Confluence.
- Team Alignment & Blocker Tracking: Follow up on daily progress, identify potential risks or blockers early, and help clear paths for engineers and designers.
- Client & Stakeholder Communication: Draft meeting summaries, action items, and weekly progress reports for clients and internal teams.
- Delivery Support: Track project status, deadlines, and basic team metrics to ensure visibility across the sprint lifecycle.
- AI-Powered Workflow: Utilize AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to streamline administrative tasks, draft documentation, and analyze project notes efficiently.

Requisitos

- Background/Interest: Bachelor's degree or current studies in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or related fields.
- Foundation in Agile: Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum principles and software development lifecycles (certifications or coursework are a plus).
- Tech Tooling Familiarity: Basic exposure or hands-on experience using project management software like Jira, Trello, or Asana.
- Outstanding Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills (English B2+/C1 is required for international client interaction).
- Proactive Mindset: High sense of ownership, willingness to ask questions, curiosity, and eagerness to learn fast.
- Technical Curiosity: Basic familiarity with software concepts (APIs, web/mobile apps, QA testing) to effectively communicate with technical teams.

Nice-to-Haves
- Previous experience in an internship, project coordination, or Scrum Master support role in tech/software.
- Basic familiarity with AI tools for productivity and task organization.
- CAPM, PSM I, or Scrum Master fundamental certifications.

Ventajas

  • 100% Remote Work Environment.

  • Opportunity to work with international clients and distributed teams.

  • Exposure to a wide variety of projects and industries.

  • Professional growth and mentorship opportunities.

  • Collaborative and supportive company culture.

  • Modern tools, processes, and AI-driven workflows.

  • Flexible and results-oriented work environment.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager, Identification & JS Agent
jobs.jd_full:
Fingerprint empowers enterprises to detect and stop online fraud with the world’s most accurate device intelligence.  We lead our industry with bleeding-edge identification capabilities and work on turning new ideas and discoveries in the fraud detection space into reality. Our customers range from innovative startups to leading enterprise companies, including Plaid, Dropbox, and Booking.com. 

Fingerprint is a globally dispersed, 100% remote company. We were named on on the 2026 Forbes Best Startup Employers list and ranked #803 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies. 

We have raised $77M and are backed by Craft Ventures (Tesla, Facebook, Airbnb ), Nexus Venture Partners ( Postman, Apollo.io, MinIO, Druva) and Uncorrelated Ventures ( Redis, Rollbar,  Gradle).

 

 

About the Role

Fingerprint is looking for a Technical Product Manager (P3) to help turn product strategy into clear, well-executed product delivery. This role is ideal for someone who is building strong product management fundamentals, enjoys working closely with engineering and design, and is energized by keeping product work organized, well-documented, and moving toward release.

In this role, you will own specific product features or workstreams under the guidance of a Sr Technical Product Manager. You will help translate product intent into clear user stories, jobs-to-be-done, acceptance criteria, release plans, documentation, and operational updates. You will work across Product, Engineering, Design, Product Analytics, Customer Success, Sales, and Product Marketing to ensure product records are accurate, dependencies are visible, stakeholders are informed, and shipped work meets the expected customer and business outcomes.

This role blends TPM expectations with the Delivery Product Owner operating model: the Sr TPM sets product direction, priorities, success metrics, and major tradeoffs; the TPM helps ensure that direction becomes shippable, well-understood, and well-supported product increments.

What you’ll do

Product delivery and execution

  • Own delivery coordination for specific product features, epics, or workstreams within priorities and constraints set by the Sr TPM.
  • Translate Sr TPM intent into clear user stories, jobs-to-be-done, acceptance criteria, and definitions of done.
  • Maintain Jira epics, tasks, acceptance criteria, and delivery status in partnership with Engineering.
  • Keep systems of record accurate and current, including Notion, Jira, Productboard, and relevant roadmap or release tracking tools.
  • Support backlog refinement, sprint-ready sequencing, and release readiness activities.
  • Track delivery risks, open questions, dependencies, and decisions; escalate when a change impacts goals, metrics, customer commitments, timeline, scope, pricing, eligibility, or cross-stakeholder priorities.
  • Attend technical reviews and build enough technical context to follow architecture, implementation, and tradeoff discussions.

Product documentation and communication

  • Create and maintain clear feature documentation with oversight from a more senior TPM.
  • Document product use cases and represent assigned feature use cases confidently with internal stakeholders.
  • Support PRDs by creating clear user stories, JTBD, acceptance criteria, and customer/business context for assigned features.
  • Draft or support internal release notes, product updates, and stakeholder communications.
  • Help ensure developer documentation is updated when product behavior changes.
  • Communicate feature status, known limitations, delivery timing, and release readiness to internal stakeholders.

Customer, market, and product insight

  • Monitor relevant customer feedback channels, support channels, Productboard insights, and internal stakeholder requests.
  • Create insights for issues that may qualify as product limitations or product improvements.
  • Participate in customer discovery, customer brainstorms, user experience discussions, and product feedback sessions.
  • Collect qualitative and quantitative data to support prioritization conversations.
  • Understand the competitive landscape for assigned product areas and stay aware of relevant technical or market developments.

Product operations and launch support

  • Help maintain roadmap and feature records as work progresses through lifecycle stages.
  • Support product launch readiness by coordinating across Engineering, Product Marketing, CS, Sales, and Support.
  • Assist Product Marketing with customer education materials, release communication, and launch artifacts.
  • Help prepare product updates for internal forums such as CS/SE syncs or release channels.
  • Track post-launch success metrics for epics and issues, and help summarize learnings for future iterations.

What success looks like

A successful TPM at Fingerprint:

  • Owns specific product features or workstreams reliably, while operating within product priorities set by a Sr TPM or product leader.
  • Creates clear, actionable user stories, JTBD, acceptance criteria, and feature documentation.
  • Keeps Jira, Notion, Productboard, and roadmap records accurate and up to date.
  • Understands the technical domain well enough to articulate the needs of technical personas and participate in technical discussions.
  • Reviews Jira epics, tasks, and acceptance criteria with the Team Lead and Sr TPM.
  • Understands engineering estimates and can communicate delivery implications to the appropriate internal stakeholders with support.
  • Talks about and demonstrates specific product features confidently to internal stakeholders.
  • Articulates the product roadmap and current feature priorities, including relevant business priorities and JTBD, with assistance.
  • Collects qualitative and quantitative inputs for prioritization decisions.
  • Understands success metrics for epics and issues and helps track metrics post-launch.
  • Escalates appropriately when a decision moves beyond delivery execution and affects customer promises, business outcomes, product metrics, pricing, eligibility, or strategic priority.

Requirements for Success

  • Experience in product management, product ownership, business or product analysis, technical program management, solutions or support engineering, or a similar role working with technical products such as APIs, SaaS platforms, developer tools, fraud prevention, security, or analytics.
  • Strong written communication skills, including creating structured product documentation, developer guides, and stakeholder updates.
  • Familiarity with agile product development, backlog management, release readiness, and cross-functional delivery workflows for API and data-centric products.
  • Ability to partner with Engineering and Design to clarify requirements, acceptance criteria, and user experience expectations; comfort reading technical documentation and discussing implementation details with engineers.
  • Ability to use product analytics, customer feedback, and stakeholder input to support product decisions, with experience using tools such as Productboard, Notion, Jira, Amplitude, Sigma, SQL, or similar systems.
  • Attention to detail, reliable follow-through, and ownership of operational details, with a bias toward making ambiguous work clearer for the team.
  • Curiosity about customer problems, technical systems, and business tradeoffs; willingness to ask questions, suggest ideas, and learn product strategy through hands-on execution.
  • Experience supporting product launches, release notes, customer education, or GTM coordination.

Compensation & Transparency

At Fingerprint, we believe in pay transparency — it’s part of how we operate as a distributed, remote-first team. Salaries are based on function, level, and geographic location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies.

Because this role is open across the United States and can be based anywhere our team members work from, the salary range reflects that geographic breadth: $126k - $170k

Some example salaries for specific locations are below:

  • NYC: $148k - $170k
  • Chicago: $126k - $145k

Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including the successful candidate’s location, experience, and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

Due to regulatory and security reasons, there’s a small number of countries where we cannot have Fingerprint teammates based. Additionally, because Fingerprint is an all-remote company and people can join our workforce from almost any country, we do not sponsor visas. Fingerprint teammates need to be authorized to work from their home location.

We are dedicated to creating an inclusive work environment for everyone. We embrace and celebrate the unique experiences, perspectives and cultural backgrounds that each employee brings to our workplace. Fingerprint strives to foster an environment where our employees feel respected, valued and empowered, and our team members are at the forefront in helping us promote and sustain an inclusive workplace. We highly encourage people from underrepresented groups in tech to apply.

If you are applying as a resident of California, please read our CCPA notice here.

If you are applying as a resident of the EU, please read our GDPR notice here.

**We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates’ personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Fingerprint recruiting email communications will always come from the @fingerprint.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Fingerprint via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, AI Products & Agentic Hospitality (f/m/d)
jobs.jd_full:
About the role

 

At Apaleo, we’re building the open, API-first property management platform for hospitality. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, and the first AI agent marketplace for hospitality in our Agent Hub, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers. 

We’re looking for a senior Product Manager to ownin our AI product domain. You’ll turn our AI capabilities into coherent, commercially viable products that solve real operational problems for hoteliers. Your goal is to help hotels move towards genuinely autonomous operations, not to ship isolated automations or AI assistants. 

This is not a backlog role. You’ll take an ambiguous opportunity, find the right customer problems, define the proposition, build it with Engineering, bring it to market and drive adoption. You’ll also play a central role in turning our AI capabilities into a meaningful and growing source of revenue. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with real autonomy. You won’t receive a roadmap and execute it. You’ll shape it along our vision, using customer insight, data and sound reasoning. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing and Customer Success, and in close collaboration with our other value stream teams.  

 

What you’ll be up to

  • Productising and commercialising our AI capabilities. Define the proposition, target customers and use cases, and shape packaging and launch with commercial teams.

  • Building the foundations for AI across our ecosystem. Shape how our AI capabilities understand each hotel’s context and work reliably with Apaleo and connected systems across operational areas.

  • Productising hospitality knowledge. Turn hospitality expertise and operational processes into scalable product experiences, with appropriate human oversight.

  • Driving autonomy and measurable value. Think in complete outcomes, such as staff hours saved and manual work removed. Show hoteliers tangible ROI.

  • Driving adoption. Run discovery, shape onboarding and usability, measure adoption and improve from real-world feedback.

  • Keeping AI products reliable and viable. Define good agent performance, understand cost and latency, set up evaluation and monitoring with Engineering, and trade off autonomy, reliability, human intervention and cost.

  • Owning strategy, roadmap and delivery in your scope, with clear specs, a definition of done and impact analysis.

  • Working with Engineering on trade-offs, dependencies, quality and our API-first AI-first architecture.

  • Balancing ambition with reality. Weigh the roadmap against operational requests, bugs and technical debt, and say no to good ideas that aren’t great ones.

  • Spotting dependencies early with Hotel Operations and other engineering teams, since our AI capabilities build on the core platform.

  • Using AI in your own PM work and championing AI-assisted engineering.

 

What you’ll bring

  • 6+ years as a Product Manager, owning products from discovery through launch and adoption with limited day-to-day direction.

  • Proven zero-to-one experience. You’ve taken a new B2B product, not a feature, from an ambiguous problem to paying customers, driving discovery, validation, definition, prioritisation and launch.

  • Ownership after launch. You’ve owned a revenue, adoption or retention number and can tell us what moved and what you killed, pivoted or repriced.

  • Commercial thinking. You’ve defined propositions, packaging and pricing, validated willingness to pay and worked with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success on go-to-market.

  • Systems and process thinking. You break processes into steps, decisions and handoffs, and understand how systems with different data models and sources of truth affect the reliability of agents.

  • Meaningful AI product experience. You’ve built and launched AI-powered products or capabilities used by real customers, understand what makes a product agentic, and can discuss context, tools, latency, cost and evaluation, with a view on human-in-the-loop design.

  • Customer centricity and product judgement. You turn interview patterns into opportunities, make tough trade-offs and prioritise ruthlessly.

  • Platform thinking. You weigh customer needs against reusable capabilities, API consistency and long-term platform evolution.

  • Stakeholder alignment. You align Engineering, commercial teams and peers, manage cross-team dependencies and communicate trade-offs with confidence.

  • Autonomy and adaptability. You take ownership, raise risks early and make progress through ambiguity.

 

Strongly preferred

  • Agentic AI products in production. You’ve taken an agentic AI product beyond prototype to paying customers, and dealt with reliability, permissions, exceptions, human intervention and evaluation. This is different from AI-powered features such as chatbots, summarisation or copilots.

Nice to have

  • Hospitality technology or hotel operations experience.

  • Experience with PMS, RMS, CRS, channel managers, OTAs or hospitality distribution.

  • Experience in B2B SaaS platforms, ecosystems or integration-heavy products.

  • Experience with AI governance, permissions, identity, orchestration or enterprise AI adoption.

  • Experience in a fast-moving startup or scale-up.

  • Comfort with AI-assisted engineering processes.

 

Don’t tick every box? Hospitality experience is an advantage, not a prerequisite. A strong zero-to-one B2B product builder from another domain, with real AI product experience and a commercial mindset, can be a better fit than a hospitality specialist without them. We’d still love to hear from you. 

 

Who you are

  • You take high ownership. You answer for product outcomes, not just delivery commitments.

  • You’re strategic and hands-on. You can set a product vision and still get into customer discovery, operational processes and detailed product decisions.

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity. You make progress when the problem or the solution isn’t fully defined.

  • You think commercially. You ask what customers will buy and why, not just what Engineering can build.

  • You’re customer obsessed. You understand real operational pain and test your assumptions with customers.

  • You’re technically curious. You know enough about AI and agentic systems to hold meaningful discussions with engineers and make informed product decisions.

  • You measure what matters. You judge success by customer outcomes, adoption and commercial impact, not features shipped.

 

What we offer

Culture and growth

  • A diverse and international team. Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique perspectives and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.

  • Growth and development. You’ll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Trading
jobs.jd_full:
COMPANY

At 0x, our mission is to “Create a Tokenized World Where All Forms of Value Can Flow Freely”. We deliver this to web3 builders with a delightfully simple suite of developer APIs that provide faster trading, better prices, and superior user experience.

Founded in 2017, we’ve processed over 211M+ transactions and $180B+ in trading volume from users trading on Matcha, Coinbase Wallet, Robinhood Wallet, Phantom, Rainbow, DefiLlama, MetaMask, Zerion, Zapper, and many more. Our investors include Greylock Partners, Pantera Capital, and Jump Crypto.

When you join 0x, you’ll become part of a veteran team of crypto builders who know the importance of code quality, team cohesion, and a culture of learning.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to work directly with our CEO across our suite of trading APIs and new product initiatives. This is a hands-on IC role on a lean product team. You’ll be deep in the data, close to customers, and working alongside engineers from concept through to launch.

This suits a strategic operator with a founder mentality. You take ownership, default to action, and drive things end to end without waiting for explicit instructions. When the data is incomplete, you form a thesis and validate it with prototypes, fast experiments, and tight iterations.

What you’ll do

  • Own strategy and roadmap for your product area - an existing set of our trading APIs or a net-new initiative

  • Form your product ideas and decisions from three independent sources, not one:

    • What customers tell you. Have regular check-ins with them, analyze their metrics, understand their pain points and what they’re building next
    • What customers can’t tell you. Dig into onchain and internal data to spot gaps in our performance, shifts in the competitive landscape, and emerging opportunities
    • What you see yourself. You’re plugged into DeFi and active in trading communities. You know firsthand what works and what doesn’t

  • Be a true partner to our engineering leads - reason through hard problems with them, weigh the tradeoffs, and decide what’s worth building

  • Partner with GTM on positioning and driving adoption

  • Work directly with the CEO and leadership to help shape product direction

Who you are

  • 6+ years in product, or the equivalent as a founder, GM, or trader who moved into building
  • Shipped B2B, API, or infra products with real adoption and revenue
  • Data-driven - you build your own Dune dashboards and dig into API performance and internal analytics in Grafana, Metabase, or similar
  • Technically fluent - you hold your own with engineers on routing, execution quality, latency, and whatever else the problem demands
  • DeFi-native - onchain trading, perps, dex aggregation. You’re the user you’re building for
  • Expert AI user - you run agents, automate your workflows, and build tooling that multiplies your output
  • You exhibit our core values: do the right thing, consistently ship, and focus on long-term impact

Nice to have

jobs.title: Senior Implementation Project Manager
jobs.jd_full:
About Rad AI

At Rad AI, we’re on a mission to transform healthcare with artificial intelligence. Founded by a radiologist, our AI-driven solutions are revolutionizing radiology—saving time, reducing burnout, and improving patient care. With one of the largest proprietary radiology report datasets in the world, our AI has helped uncover hundreds of new cancer diagnoses and reduced error rates in tens of millions of radiology reports by nearly 50%.

Rad AI has secured over $140M in funding, including a recently oversubscribed Series C ($68M round) led by Transformation Capital, bringing our valuation to $528M. Our investors include Khosla Ventures, World Innovation Lab, Gradient Ventures, Cone Health Ventures, and others—all backing our mission to empower physicians with cutting-edge AI.

Our latest advancements in generative AI are used by thousands of radiologists daily, supporting more than one-third of radiology groups and healthcare systems and nearly 50% of all medical imaging in the U.S. at partners including Cone Health, Jefferson Einstein Health, Geisinger, Guthrie Healthcare System, and Henry Ford Health.

Recognized as one of the most promising healthcare AI companies by CB Insights and AuntMinnie, and ranked by Deloitte as the 19th fastest-growing company in North America, we are building AI-powered solutions that make a real impact. Most recently, Rad AI was named to CNBC’s Disruptor 50 list, highlighting the innovation and momentum behind our mission.

If you’re ready to shape the future of healthcare, we’d love to have you on our team!

Why Join Us:

At Rad AI, we combine world-class radiology and AI expertise to build products that maximize radiologist productivity, expand access to high-quality care, and improve patient outcomes. Join us and help transform how radiology is practiced for patients and health systems around the world.

We are looking for an Implementation Project Manager with deep experience leading software implementation projects. As Rad AI’s award-winning platform continues its rapid adoption, you will play a key role in guiding customers through successful deployments. You bring a proactive, “can do” mindset and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where adaptability and collaboration are essential.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Work independently to plan, monitor, and manage multiple complex customer-facing projects
  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of Rad AI’s products to radiology practices and health systems, from kick-off to go-live and transition to support
  • Own implementation readiness and go-live planning, coordinating testing, training, customer preparedness, cutover activities, and post-launch transition. Identify readiness gaps early and develop actionable recovery plans when milestones or commitments are at risk
  • Maintain accurate, current project plans, milestones, forecasts, risks, decisions, and action items in established project management systems, ensuring clear ownership, timely follow-through, and reliable visibility for stakeholders
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams, including Product, Engineering, and Integration resources, to meet project objectives and deadlines
  • Serve as the primary client-facing contact throughout the implementation
  • Ensure a smooth onboarding process by managing project timelines, dependencies, and communications with executive, clinical, and IT stakeholders
  • Track and manage feature requests, ensuring clear communication, documentation, and prioritization
  • Anticipate and actively manage project risks, dependencies, and potential delays; develop and track mitigation plans, communicate threats early, and escalate material issues with clear business impact, recommended actions, and accountable owners
  • Proactively investigate challenges, assess root causes and business impact, evaluate options, and recommend practical solutions. Exercise sound judgment within established authority and escalate decisions with clear recommendations when needed
  • Conduct weekly status meetings with internal and external stakeholders
  • Collaborate and coordinate with Rad AI’s product, engineering, and customer success teams for project goal setting, data integration, testing, and product feedback
  • Provide ongoing updates to leadership throughout the project, via dashboards and reports
  • Foster transparent, respectful, and solutions-focused partnerships with customers and internal teams, navigating competing priorities, addressing difficult conversations constructively, and driving alignment on decisions and commitments
  • Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes, documentation, and customer outcomes; proactively propose and help implement practical solutions, contribute lessons learned, and support adoption of agreed improvements.
  • Contribute to building a world-class implementation organization that aims to exceed customer expectations with attentive, responsive, and knowledgeable service

Who We’re Looking For:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above
  • At least 2 plus years of relevant project management, implementation management, technical project management, or similar client-facing experience, preferably within a healthcare/healthcare IT environment
  • Strong project planning and execution skills, including timeline, scope, and risk management
  • Prior experience or familiarity with radiology workflows and/or radiology-specific healthcare IT
  • Prior professional consulting or healthcare software implementation experience
  • Prior experience or familiarity with radiology workflows
  • Prior experience or familiarity with HL7, FHIR, and EHRs
  • Excellent people/relationship management and communication skills, with the ability to navigate challenging conversations, influence without authority, and hold stakeholders accountable respectfully
  • Practical working knowledge of SaaS solutions, implementations, and technical concepts
  • Eagerness to continuously learn, adapt, improve, and help others do so in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships with all functions and areas of the company to share in challenges and successes, and work collaboratively towards common goals
  • Proficiency with project management tools

Join our world-class team as we build and deploy AI solutions that empower physicians and transform patient care—making a meaningful impact on millions of lives. Driven by our mission,  we prioritize transparency, inclusion, and close collaboration, bringing together exceptional people to revolutionize healthcare. If you’re passionate about driving innovation and delivering impactful healthcare solutions, we’d love to hear from you!

To learn more about what it’s like to work at Rad AI, visit https://www.radai.com/life-at-rad-ai and be sure to follow us on LinkedIn to stay up to date!

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – Platform & Data
jobs.jd_full:
Own the platform underneath safetyOS™: the shared services and data every Securly product runs on.

Securly keeps students safe in 27,000+ schools, and our technology has helped save 2,400+ student lives. Nine products run on one platform. We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager – Platform & Data to make it work as one system for every district.

THE ROLE

You’ll own strategy and the roadmap across three layers:

  • Core platform services: SSO, SIS and rostering integrations through Sync, and data acquisition, with real availability and SLO accountability.
  • Data platform: you own the product requirements for our layered data pipeline, from raw district data to clean, trusted data every product uses. Our Data team owns how it’s built.
  • Customer-facing data products: the data marts, APIs and reporting district leaders act on.

You’ll work with our CTO, Engineering in the U.S. and Pune, the Data team, product leads for every product line, and Customer Success.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Set the strategy and roadmap across platform services, the data platform and data products.
  • Define and hold SLOs for SSO, SIS integrations and data acquisition.
  • Own SIS integrations and data acquisition so rostering data arrives reliably from every district.
  • Define what each pipeline layer delivers, from raw ingestion to curated data, and set data quality standards with the Data team.
  • Own shared metrics and data models, so terms like “active student” and “screen time” mean the same thing in every product.
  • Build in student data privacy: FERPA, COPPA and state privacy laws shape every data decision.
  • Ship data products districts use directly, from discovery to adoption.
  • Decide what’s built once for the platform and what stays with each product.
  • Make onboarding one step: one setup, every product working together.
  • Stay close to customers: district IT directors and administrators shape your roadmap.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • 90 days: You’ve mapped our data flows, met key partners, and set SLO targets and a first roadmap.
  • 6 months: You run platform planning, and product teams build on your standards.
  • 12 months: You can show faster onboarding, higher uptime and cross-product reporting districts trust.

WHAT YOU BRING

Must have

  • 7+ years in product management, including end-to-end ownership of a data platform product
  • Layered data architecture: raw data lands, gets cleaned and standardized, then becomes curated data ready for reporting. Medallion (bronze, silver, gold) is a plus; lakehouse, data warehouse or similar staged pipelines count too.
  • Data modeling and shared metric definitions across multiple products or data sources
  • Customer-facing data products: data marts, APIs or reporting
  • Shared runtime services with SLO accountability
  • Based in the U.S. and authorized to work without visa sponsorship

Strongly preferred

  • Student data privacy: FERPA, COPPA and state privacy laws, or comparable regulated data such as HIPAA
  • K-12 SIS and rostering: PowerSchool, Infinite Campus, Clever, ClassLink or OneRoster
  • Ingestion and sync from many external sources at scale
  • Identity and SSO: SAML, OIDC, Google and Microsoft sign-in

Nice to have

  • K-12 EdTech experience

WHO YOU ARE

  • You think in data flows and catch quality issues before customers do.
  • You lead through influence and make the teams around you better.
  • You’re credible in both rooms: deep with data engineers, clear with executives.
  • You use AI daily and know where it helps.

WHY SECURLY

  • Top-tier medical, dental and vision coverage
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Unlimited PTO plus a paid year-end shutdown
  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave
  • Free 24⁄7 confidential mental health counseling and wellness tools
  • $1,000 annual learning stipend
  • Structured onboarding and ongoing coaching

Our people-first culture shows in the numbers: 82% employee engagement against a 73% global benchmark, and 94% of employees proud to work here (Securly Qualtrics Employee Survey, 2025; WSA Global Benchmark).

ABOUT SECURLY

Securly launched the first cloud-based K-12 web filter in 2013. Today safetyOS™ covers everything a district needs to keep students safe, secure and ready to learn:

  • Unified Experience: single sign-on, SIS integrations and self-deployment
  • Digital Safety: filtering that handles 20% of U.S. K-12 internet traffic
  • AI Governance: guardrails and visibility as students use AI
  • Student Wellness: 24⁄7 monitoring with human-verified alerts
  • Classroom Management: classroom, device and flex period management
  • Campus Movement: 2 million digital hall passes created every day
  • Family Engagement: visibility for parents into their child’s digital life
  • Digital Insights: reporting on tech and AI use, screen time and circumvention

Every one of these runs on the platform this role owns.

Remote within the United States. We are not able to sponsor visas for this position. We review applications on a rolling basis, so apply early.

Securly is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a diverse, inclusive workplace. If you need an accommodation during the hiring process, email recruitment.us@securly.com.

jobs.jd_full:
Who Are Massive Rocket?

Massive Rocket is a rapidly scaling Braze and Snowflake agency on a mission to transform how digital marketing, product, and engineering teams connect. In just five years, we’ve grown at speed and are now gearing up for our next big milestone: hitting $100M in revenue. We build human experiences at scale, powered by cutting‑edge web, mobile, cloud, data, and AI technologies. If you’re excited by innovation, love solving complex challenges, and want to help shape the future of digital experiences, you’ll feel right at home here.

 

Every role at Massive Rocket is entrepreneurial. The people who thrive here don’t just focus on their own remit — they understand the goals of the teams around them and actively contribute to the success of their colleagues, customers, and partners. We’re building a culture of ownership, collaboration, and growth, and we’re looking for people who want to make a real impact.

 

Who Are We Looking to Add to Our Team?

We’re looking for an experienced Program Manager to lead Massive Rocket’s most complex and strategically important client programmes. You’ll take ownership of large, multi-project engagements, working with senior client stakeholders and internal teams to ensure programmes deliver strong commercial and business outcomes.

As a senior delivery leader, you’ll go beyond managing individual projects. You’ll shape how programmes are delivered, identify opportunities for account growth, and help develop the next generation of Programme and Project Managers across Massive Rocket.

What Will You Do?

  • Lead complex, multi-project programmes for major client accounts, ensuring delivery remains aligned with strategic and commercial objectives.
  • Build strong relationships with executive-level stakeholders across multiple business units and act as a trusted delivery partner.
  • Oversee programme budgets across multiple Statements of Work, ensuring strong commercial performance and identifying growth opportunities.
  • Drive delivery quality across CRM, loyalty, customer data, Braze, Snowflake, and wider MarTech initiatives.
  • Lead globally distributed teams across multiple time zones, establishing clear governance, communication, and ways of working.
  • Mentor and develop senior Project and Programme Managers, helping strengthen delivery capability across the business.
  • Contribute to the evolution of Massive Rocket’s programme delivery methodology and best practices.
  • Identify and adopt AI and automation opportunities that improve delivery efficiency, reporting, and programme management.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in Project and Programme Management.
  • Proven experience leading complex, multi-project programmes with significant annual revenue.
  • A strong track record of delivering sustained commercial impact across multiple major Tier 1 client accounts.
  • Executive-level stakeholder management experience across complex organisations and multiple business units.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including experience managing multi-SOW budgets and supporting account growth strategies.
  • Experience mentoring and developing senior Project or Programme Management talent.
  • Deep understanding of CRM, loyalty, data strategy, Braze, and Snowflake, with the ability to oversee delivery across these areas at programme level.
  • Experience using AI and automation to improve delivery practices and operational efficiency.
  • Proven experience leading globally distributed teams and establishing effective cross-timezone and asynchronous ways of working.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage complex programmes and competing priorities.

Desirable

  • Published thought leadership or conference speaking experience in MarTech or Programme Management.
  • MSP Practitioner, PgMP, MoP, or another relevant portfolio or programme management certification.
  • Experience shaping programme delivery standards and methodologies within an agency, consultancy, or fast-growing technology environment.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

• Rocket‑Fuelled Growth – Big challenges, fast learning, and the chance to level up quicker than anywhere else

• A Culture That Actually Gives a Damn – Supportive, positive, and built around people who want to see you win

• A Global Crew – Collaborate with brilliant teammates across Europe, the US, and beyond

• Remote‑First for Life – Work from wherever you feel your best

• Real Career Momentum – Clear progression, real ownership, and space to grow into your next chapter

• Moments That Matter – Meetups, events, and team experiences that make the journey unforgettable

 

A Few Things to Know Before We Get Started

Bring Your Own Device – We operate a BYOD policy, so you’ll use your own kit for work

Right to Work – You’ll need a valid work visa; we’re not able to offer sponsorship at the moment

ID Checks – We may ask for proof of identity (passport, ID card, or a recent utility bill)

References – We may request two references, so have names, relationships, and contact details ready

For Contractors – Proof of incorporation and up‑to‑date insurance is required

 

A Quick Note on Applications

We receive a high volume of applications, and while we’d love to reply to everyone personally, it’s not always possible. If you haven’t heard from us within two weeks, it sadly means you haven’t been successful this time. But don’t let that stop you—we’re growing fast, and new opportunities open up all the time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
